officialText:
As a condition of license renewal, a licensed master or special rigger shall provide evidence satisfactory to the department that he or she is fit to perform the work.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.

Article 405: Hoisting Machine Operator License
